session_ai_summaries_document_type_check.name: session_ai_summaries_document_type_check
session_ai_summaries_document_type_check.value: document_type IS NULL OR document_type IN ('AADHAAR', 'PAN')

session_ai_summaries_document_status_che.name: session_ai_summaries_document_status_check
session_ai_summaries_document_status_che.value: document_status IS NULL OR document_status IN ('VERIFIED', 'NOT_VERIFIED', 'UNREADABLE', 'UNAVAILABLE')

session_ai_summaries_document_complete.name: session_ai_summaries_document_complete
session_ai_summaries_document_complete.value:
("session_ai_summaries"."document_type" IS NULL AND "session_ai_summaries"."document_status" IS NULL AND "session_ai_summaries"."document_checked_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("session_ai_summaries"."document_type" IS NOT NULL AND "session_ai_summaries"."document_status" IS NOT NULL AND "session_ai_summaries"."document_checked_at" IS NOT NULL)

session_checklist_items_checked_at_consi.name: session_checklist_items_checked_at_consistent
session_checklist_items_checked_at_consi.value: ("session_checklist_items"."checked" = false AND "session_checklist_items"."checked_at" IS NULL) OR ("session_checklist_items"."checked" = true AND "session_checklist_items"."checked_at" IS NOT NULL)

sessions_verdict_check.name: sessions_verdict_check
sessions_verdict_check.value: verdict IS NULL OR verdict IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'ABORTED')

sessions_bill_category_check.name: sessions_bill_category_check
sessions_bill_category_check.value: bill_category IS NULL OR bill_category IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED')
